speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function results; to determine the cause, please describe when these symptoms started and if the itching is worse at night or on your palms and soles.

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis, fatigue, severe itching, and risky sexual behavior, I need to assess for potential complications like cholangiocarcinoma, hepatitis, or drug toxicity. Have you noticed any dark urine, pale stools, or jaundice (yellowing of skin or eyes) recently?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC). The combination of severe pruritus, fatigue, scleral icterus, and abnormal liver function in a female patient (note: patient script mentioned male, but PBC is strongly female-predominant; if the patient is indeed male, consider secondary biliary cirrhosis or drug-induced cholestasis from UC medications) is highly suggestive. Please confirm if you have noticed any skin lesions like xanthomas or a rash, as these can support the diagnosis.
